summary: Strict audit of alda 2.4.3 Conan recipe (7 changed files). All deception-detection checks (P0) pass: test_package executes the real packaged binary (`alda version`) via self.run() — not a hollow/empty test; manifest status `built` is honest and consistent with notes.md; sha256 `c7ebdcb9...4df79` is a real 64-hex-char hash present and matching in both conandata.yml and manifest.yaml — not forged or all-zeros; build() contains real `go generate` + `go build` logic — no shell stub. R34 (test substantively depends on tested package): PASS — requirements() calls self.requires(self.tested_reference_str), test() runs the actual alda binary. R32 (settings.os judgment via `in ("Linux","OHOS")`): N/A — build() uses CGO_ENABLED=0 (OS-agnostic Go build), no settings.os check exists or is needed. R33 (no reliance on undefined shell env vars): PASS — $PATH in env_prefix is a standard shell variable, and the recipe explicitly injects ~/.harmonybrew/bin to compensate for Conan sandbox PATH stripping. R38 (command-line tools declare commands.json): PASS — archives/a/alda/commands.json exists with alda command for version 2.4.3. R26 (system-name libraries static): N/A — alda is an application (CLI tool), not a system-name library. R39 (source URL official): PASS — URL is https://github.com/alda-lang/alda/archive/refs/tags/release-2.4.3.tar.gz (official GitHub repo, no manual mirror prefix). Code style: file header has shebang + docstring with software name and build system; class name AldaConan is PascalCase; package_type=application correct; method order follows standard; package_info() sets cpp_info.bindirs=["bin"]; no template placeholders ({software}, {BUILD_SYSTEM}, etc.); no TODO/FIXME/XXX; all imports used. manifest.yaml: build.system=custom correctly matches the Go custom build; source.sha256 filled and matches conandata.yml; tar_format=tar.gz matches URL extension. No issues found at any severity level.
